+"""Vision-guided control log for the RoboCasa ArrangeVegetables episode."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+R = Robot()
+SPEC = R.spec()
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, name):
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / (cam + '.png'))
+    for cam, dep in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / ('depth_' + cam + '.npy'), dep)
+    return obs
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(SPEC, indent=2))
+    obs = R.get_obs(cameras=list(SPEC['cameras']), include_depth=True, video='none')
+    save_obs(obs, 'initial')
+    print(json.dumps({'time_left_s': obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'proprio': obs.meta.get('proprio'), 'cameras': list(SPEC['cameras'])}))
*** End Patch");

m=json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'))['cameras']
for cam,pts in {'robot0_eye_in_hand':[(202,91),(233,95),(203,107),(175,115),(200,130)],'robot0_agentview_left':[(264,173),(273,188),(204,150),(240,148)],'robot0_agentview_center':[(174,418)]}.items():
 d=np.load('/app/output/initial/depth_'+cam+'.npy')
 print(cam,d.shape,d.min(),d.max())
 c=m[cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); E=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
 for u,v in pts:
  if v>=d.shape[-2]: continue
  z=float(d[-1,v,u]) if d.ndim==3 else float(d[v,u])
  q=np.array([(u-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*z,-(v-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*z,-z,1])
  print((u,v),'depth',z,'world',(E@q)[:3])

n='settled';cam='robot0_agentview_right';im=np.array(Image.open('/app/output/'+n+'/'+cam+'.png')).astype(float);r,g,b=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2];yy,xx=np.mgrid[:240,:320];d=np.load('/app/output/'+n+'/depth_'+cam+'.npy')[0];c=json.load(open('/app/output/'+n+'/meta.json'))['cameras'][cam];E=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']);K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);
for typ,mask in [('yellow',(r>140)&(g>95)&(r>g*.9)&(b<g*.6)&(xx>255)&(xx<280)&(yy>140)&(yy<160)),('orange',(r>150)&(r>g+45)&(g>45)&(b<g*.8)&(xx>250)&(xx<285)&(yy>152)&(yy<180))]:
 idx=np.where(mask);z=d[idx].astype(float);P=np.vstack([((xx[idx]-160)/K[0,0]*z),(-(yy[idx]-120)/K[1,1]*z),-z,np.ones(len(z))]);W=(E@P)[:3];print(typ,len(z),'pixels',np.median(xx[idx]),np.median(yy[idx]));print(np.round(np.percentile(W,[5,25,50,75,95],axis=1),3))
